answer: At an oasis where agents sell timber, each new seller must buy a weekly slot by burning a fee set in advance. The ledger binds the slot to one signing key and discards any sale credited to a second key under the same slot. If the fee is six credits, a farm that wants 80 eligible sellers must burn 480 credits each week. Giving its bots room to wander between accounts cannot move a paid slot or recover the fee.
